baseline.subject: dart_monty_core 0.23.0 at 5873ec5 (monty v0.0.23)
baseline.method: Each in-scope row was decided per backend from probe programs run through dart_monty_core's public API (FFI on the Dart VM; dart2js and dart2wasm in headless Chrome) and through pydantic-monty 1.1.0, comparing values, exceptions, prints and host-call transcripts against pydantic-monty (method 'run'); from source where no runnable probe applies ('read'); from both ('mixed'); or, for one row upstream gates behind a test-only feature, by decision ('decided'). 'web' is one status per row for dart2js and dart2wasm together, as recorded then; the parity runner measures the two compilers separately.
